nodes.name: PSC/NF hydrothermal synthesis
nodes.procedure: One piece (1 cm×3 cm) of pre-treated NF (See Supporting Information for experimental details of NF treatment). The growth solution was prepared by dissolving 0.06 mol·L⁻¹ Cobalt (II) nitrate hexahydrate, 0.03 mol·L⁻¹ Iron (III) nitrate nonahydrate and 0.25 mol·L⁻¹ urea in 40 mL of deionized water. One piece of NF was submersed in the above solution, and precursor was directly grown onto the commercial NF at 100°C for 3 h in an electric oven. The resulting PSC/NF was washed with ethanol twice and dried in a vacuum oven at 60°C overnight.
nodes.source_text: The preparation of PSC/NF was achieved via one step hydrothermal synthesis in presence of one piece (1cm×3cm) of pre-treated NF... The resulting PSC/NF was washed with ethanol twice and dried in a vacuum oven at 60°C overnight.

nodes.name: 2-APSC/NF ligand modification
nodes.procedure: 300 mg of 2-Aminoterephthalic Acid was dissolved in 30 mL dimethylformamide (DMF), and the resulting solution was transferred into a 50 mL Teflon-lined stainless-steel autoclave. The PSC/NF were submersed into the above solution, heated at 160°C for 12 h in an electric oven and then cooled down to room temperature naturally. The resulting 2-APSC/NF was washed with ethanol twice and dried in a vacuum oven at 60°C overnight.
